_doc: Pons Garden flora roster. THIRTY LISTED COMPANIES, six tiers x five. Each entry has a stable neutral `id` (drawn from the SAFE name, so internal identity is permanently clean), a shared tier/sector/sapBase, and two display sets: `market` (the STOCKNAMEplant larp, ships by default) and `safe` (original IP). Only display strings differ between them - ids, tiers, sectors, sapBase and art keys are shared, which is what makes the flip one file with no migration. See PONS_GARDEN_BIBLE.md I-9 as amended 2026-09-08 and GAME_DESIGN.md s4a.
_flipPolicy: On any cease-and-desist, platform complaint, processor query, or Benjamin's word: set PONS_ROSTER=safe and rebuild. No data migration is required or permitted, because no id, save record, art key or share URL contains a market name. A test asserts both sets resolve and that ids are identical across them.
_tiers: common=Penny uncommon=SmallCap rare=MidCap epic=BlueChip legendary=Megacap mythic=Index

market.name: GAMESTOPplant
market.silhouette: a hollow corn cob in a paper crown, sat in a cinema seat
market.flavor: It refuses to be uprooted. It has refused for years.

safe.name: Husk Holdings
safe.silhouette: an ear of corn, completely hollow
safe.flavor: Nothing inside. Rattles when the wind blows.

market.name: AMCplant
market.silhouette: a popcorn-headed sprout holding a tiny ticket stub
market.flavor: The show is not over. The show is never over.

safe.name: Rugg Capital
safe.silhouette: a vine that pulls its own roots up
safe.flavor: It does this to itself. Nobody knows why.

market.name: NIKOLAplant
market.silhouette: a sprout on a slight downhill slope, coasting
market.flavor: It is moving. Technically it is moving.

safe.name: Moonwort Ventures
safe.silhouette: a seedling staring straight up
safe.flavor: Always about to. Has been about to for some time.

market.name: WEWORKplant
market.silhouette: a sprout in an enormous empty pot it is subletting
market.flavor: There is room for six more. There has always been room.

safe.name: Bagholly & Co.
safe.silhouette: a holly bush clutching a sack
safe.flavor: It is holding. It would like you to know it is holding.

market.name: PELOTONplant
market.silhouette: a sprout pedalling furiously on a tiny wheel
market.flavor: Enormous effort. Identical position.

safe.name: Pennysprout
safe.silhouette: a wide-eyed seedling holding a cardboard sign
safe.flavor: The sign is blank. It has not decided yet.

market.name: ROBINHOODplant
market.silhouette: a fern in a small green feathered cap
market.flavor: Takes from the rich. Mostly, though, from you.

safe.name: Fernance Brothers
safe.silhouette: a fern with slicked-back fronds
safe.flavor: It will explain something to you now.

market.name: PALANTIRplant
market.silhouette: a palm with a single dark eye in the trunk
market.flavor: It knows who took the thing. It is not saying.

safe.name: Panopticus Palm
safe.silhouette: a palm covered in small eyes
safe.flavor: Watches the whole village. Remembers all of it.

market.name: RIVIANplant
market.silhouette: a vine with a tiny roof rack
market.flavor: Ready. Very nearly ready.

safe.name: Voltvine
safe.silhouette: a vine with electric tendrils
safe.flavor: Do not touch it during a storm.

market.name: SNAPplant
market.silhouette: a snapdragon that forgets
market.flavor: It said something. It does not remember what.

safe.name: Ticker Tulip
safe.silhouette: a tulip whose petals scroll
safe.flavor: Readable if you stand very still.

market.name: CHEWYplant
market.silhouette: a friendly bush with an oversized bow
market.flavor: Delighted you came. Expensive about it.

safe.name: Sprout & Sons
safe.silhouette: a modest bush with a hand-painted sign
safe.flavor: Family business. The sons are not involved.

market.name: STARBUCKSplant
market.silhouette: a fig tree steaming gently from every branch
market.flavor: It is on every corner of the plaza. All of them.

safe.name: Divvy Fig
safe.silhouette: a fig that drips one bead of syrup on a schedule
safe.flavor: One bead. Every time. Very pleased about it.

market.name: FORDplant
market.silhouette: a sturdy reed with a chrome grille
market.flavor: Older than the village. Still going.

safe.name: Bullrush
safe.silhouette: a bulrush with its head down
safe.flavor: Charges its own fence. Every single time.

market.name: PFIZERplant
market.silhouette: a blue flower shaped like a lozenge
market.flavor: You feel better standing near it. That may be the point.

safe.name: Everbloom Pharma
safe.silhouette: a single perfect flower
safe.flavor: One flower. Cures one thing. Charges accordingly.

market.name: KROGERplant
market.silhouette: a wheat stalk with a tiny shopping basket
market.flavor: Everything, in bulk, slightly cheaper.

safe.name: Middling Mills
safe.silhouette: an entirely unremarkable wheat stalk
safe.flavor: Has never missed a quarter. Has never had a good one.

market.name: UPSplant
market.silhouette: a brown-leaved shrub with a parcel wedged in it
market.flavor: It was here. You were out.

safe.name: Orchard Prime
safe.silhouette: a small tree mid-throw
safe.flavor: Delivers to your other plots. Uninvited.

market.name: JPMORGANplant
market.silhouette: a begonia in a pinstriped pot
market.flavor: It has seen four crashes. It expects a fifth.

safe.name: Beargonia
safe.silhouette: a begonia with a grumpy bear's face
safe.flavor: Permanently disappointed. Occasionally correct.

market.name: COCACOLAplant
market.silhouette: a red-flowered vine that fizzes
market.flavor: The recipe is in a vault. The vault is also a plant.

safe.name: Aunt Hazel's Preserves
safe.silhouette: a berry bush beside a row of jars
safe.flavor: Jam. Only jam. Since before the village.

market.name: DISNEYplant
market.silhouette: a tall tree with two perfectly round leaves near the top
market.flavor: Beloved. Litigious. Both at full strength.

safe.name: Mahogany Board
safe.silhouette: a tree shaped like a boardroom table
safe.flavor: Seats nine. Nobody knows who the ninth is.

market.name: WALMARTplant
market.silhouette: an enormous low cactus with a yellow spark on top
market.flavor: Bigger than your garden. Costs less than your fence.

safe.name: Cornerstone Cactus
safe.silhouette: a squat, immovable cactus
safe.flavor: Has not moved since it was planted. Will not.

market.name: JOHNSONplant
market.silhouette: a cypress with two identical trunks
market.flavor: Twice the trunk. Same tree.

safe.name: Custodian Cypress
safe.silhouette: a cypress in a tiny green visor
safe.flavor: Holds everyone else's things. Never its own.

market.name: NVIDIAplant
market.silhouette: a towering sequoia veined with green light
market.flavor: The hum gets louder before it spikes. Everyone has learned this.

safe.name: Circuit Sequoia
safe.silhouette: a sequoia veined with circuitry
safe.flavor: The hum gets louder before it spikes.

market.name: APPLEplant
market.silhouette: an oak bearing one flawless fruit with a bite missing
market.flavor: The bite was there when it grew. Nobody has explained this.

safe.name: Blue Chip Oak
safe.silhouette: an oak with blue chips for leaves
safe.flavor: The leaves clink in the wind. Reassuringly.

market.name: TESLAplant
market.silhouette: a thistle throwing arcs of lightning between its spines
market.flavor: Worth more than the rest of the row combined. Ask it why.

safe.name: Trillion Thistle
safe.silhouette: a thistle far too big for its pot
safe.flavor: Too big for the pot. Entirely unbothered.

market.name: AMAZONplant
market.silhouette: a vast canopy raining small parcels
market.flavor: It has already delivered to plots you have not planted yet.

safe.name: The Orchard Giant
safe.silhouette: a canopy that covers four plots
safe.flavor: Nothing grows beneath it. Nothing needs to.

market.name: MICROSOFTplant
market.silhouette: a four-paned window flower on a pale trunk
market.flavor: Dependable. Updates at the worst possible hour.

safe.name: Softwood Systems
safe.silhouette: a pale trunk with a four-paned flower
safe.flavor: Dependable. Updates at the worst possible hour.

market.name: SP500plant
market.silhouette: a hedge made of five hundred smaller hedges
market.idle: all of it nods, slightly out of sync
market.flavor: You are not beating it. Nobody is beating it.

safe.name: The Index
safe.silhouette: a hedge made of smaller hedges
safe.flavor: Every part of it disagrees. The whole is serene.

market.name: VANGUARDplant
market.silhouette: an ancient, enormous, deeply boring tree
market.flavor: It will outlive your garden. And you. And the village.

safe.name: Steady Eddy Trust
safe.silhouette: an ancient enormous tree
safe.flavor: Boring. Enormous. Outlives everything around it.

market.name: NASDAQplant
market.silhouette: a coiled vine wound tight around a glowing post
market.flavor: It goes up. Then it goes up more. Then, briefly, it does not.

safe.name: The Short Squeeze
safe.silhouette: a vine coiled dangerously tight
safe.flavor: Snaps once, spectacularly, and is spent.

market.name: BERKSHIREplant
market.silhouette: an old hedge in reading glasses that owns the hedges around it
market.flavor: It bought the rest of this row a long time ago.

safe.name: The Hedgeaway
safe.silhouette: an old hedge in reading glasses
safe.flavor: It owns the other hedges. They have not been told.

market.name: GOLDplant
market.silhouette: a goldenrod of actual soft gold
market.flavor: Everyone remembers it exists at exactly the wrong moment.

safe.name: Goldenrod Reserve
safe.silhouette: a goldenrod of soft gold
safe.flavor: Dug up in panics. Reburied afterwards.
